The '''International Conference on Formal Power Series and Algebraic Combinatorics''' ('''FPSAC''') is an annual [[academic conference]] in the areas of [[algebraic combinatorics|algebraic]] and [[enumerative combinatorics]] and their applications and relations with other areas of mathematics, physics, biology and computer science.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://fpsac.org/about/ |title=FPSAC - About|accessdate=2023-10-25}}</ref>

==History==

FPSAC was first held in 1988 and has been held annually since 1990, typically in June or July.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://fpsac.org/confs/ |title=FPSAC - Conferences|accessdate=2023-10-25}}</ref>

The most recent conference in the series, FPSAC 2026, was held in July 2026 at the [[University of Washington]] in [[Seattle]], Washington, USA.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://sites.math.washington.edu/fpsac2026/ |title=FPSAC 2026|accessdate=2025-08-08}}</ref> The next conference is slated to take place July 5-9, 2027 at [[University of Galway]] in [[Galway]], Ireland.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://maths.universityofgalway.ie/fpsac2027/ |title=FPSAC 2027|accessdate=2026-08-14}}</ref>

The proceedings of conferences in the series have appeared variously as books published by the [[American Mathematical Society]]<ref>{{cite conference|doi=10.1090/dimacs/024|title= Formal power series and algebraic combinatorics |conference=Papers from the Sixth International Conference held in New Brunswick, New Jersey, May 23–27, 1994|date= 1996|publisher=American Mathematical Society|series=DIMACS Series in Discrete Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science|isbn= 0-8218-0324-7|editor= Louis J. Billera |editor2=Curtis Greene |editor3=Rodica Simion|editor4=Richard P. Stanley}}
</ref> and [[Springer Science+Business Media|Springer]],<ref>{{cite conference|doi=10.1007/978-3-662-04166-6|title= Formal Power Series and Algebraic Combinatorics |conference=12th International Conference, FPSAC'00, Moscow, Russia, June 2000, Proceedings|date= 2000|publisher=Springer|isbn= 978-3-642-08662-5|editor= Daniel Krob |editor2=Alexander A. Mikhalev |editor3=Alexander V. Mikhalev}}
</ref> and as issues in the journals [[Discrete Mathematics (journal)|Discrete Mathematics]],<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/discrete-mathematics/vol/153/issue/1 |title= Proceedings of the 5th Conference on Formal Power Series and Algebraic Combinatorics|journal=Discrete Mathematics|volume=153|number=1–3}}</ref> [[Discrete Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science]],<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://dmtcs.episciences.org/volume/view/id/265|journal=Discrete Mathematics & Theoretical Computer Science Proceedings|title= Proceedings of the 26th International Conference on Formal Power Series and Algebraic Combinatorics (FPSAC 2014)|volume=AT}}</ref> and [[Séminaire Lotharingien de Combinatoire]].<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.mat.univie.ac.at/~slc/wpapers/FPSAC2023/|journal=Séminaire Lotharingien de Combinatoire|volume=89B|title= Proceedings of the 35th International Conference on "Formal Power Series and Algebraic Combinatorics", July 17 - 21, 2023, University of California at Davis, USA}}</ref>

Invited speakers at previous FPSAC conferences include [[Fields Medal|Fields Medalist]] [[June Huh]], [[Shaw Prize]] and [[Wolf Prize in Mathematics|Wolf Prize]] recipient [[Noga Alon]], [[Leroy P. Steele Prize|Steele Prize]] recipient [[Richard P. Stanley|Richard Stanley]], and [[Wolf Prize in Mathematics|Wolf Prize]] and [[Leroy P. Steele Prize|Steele Prize]] recipient [[Israel Gelfand]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://fpsac.org/invited_speakers/ |title=FPSAC - All time invited speakers|accessdate=2024-09-10}}</ref>
